headline: PIT @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 4.56 at SFG 4.76, with a projected total of 9.32. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: PIT moved +0.07 runs while SFG moved +0.68, changing the projected margin by -0.61 runs. The projected total climbed +0.75, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tyler Mahle has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Lowe, Luis Arraez, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Chapman, Billy Cook because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
